typography.instructions: DO NOT use Inter or standard sans-serif for headings. Always apply tracking-tight to headings and uppercase tracking-widest for labels. Maintain high contrast.

colors.instructions: Never use pure black or pure white. Tint neutrals slightly towards cool slate (blue-ish). Limit primary color to CTAs and active states. Use semantic colors strictly for status badges (Pending/Confirmed/Rejected) and profit margins.

layouts.app_shell: Collapsible sidebar navigation on the left (`w-16` collapsed, `w-64` expanded). Main content area takes remaining space. Fixed top header with breadcrumbs, search, and user profile.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid: Base `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4` with tight `gap-4` or `gap-6`. Summary metrics span 1 column, primary charts span 2-3 columns.
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scrollable container with vertical lanes. Lanes have solid subtle backgrounds (`bg-muted/50`). Drag-and-drop cards must have `hover:-translate-y-1` and drop-shadow lift.
layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous outer padding (`p-6` to `p-8` for sections). Dense inner padding for tables and list items (`p-2` to `p-4`) to fit CRM data.
layouts.instructions: Always optical align elements. Use Subgrid where nested alignment is needed. Ensure sidebar leaves main content scrollable independently. NO centered alignment on text blocks.

components.surfaces: Neumorphic 'Clay & Crisp' variant for dashboard widgets: flat background, sharp 1px border (`border-border`), soft hover shadow. Do NOT use soft UI everywhere.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rounded corners (e.g., `rounded-md`). Primary buttons have strong background color with white text. Hover state must slightly increase brightness.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (`rounded-lg`), 1px border. No shadows on rest state. Hover: slight shadow-lg.
components.inputs_forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Light mode inputs have `bg-white` and subtle border. Focus states MUST use `ring-2 ring-primary/50`.
components.modals_sheets: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal variant) for overlays (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`). The modal itself should be solid background with crisp borders.
components.status_badges: Pill shaped (`rounded-full`), dense padding (`px-2.5 py-0.5`), bold small text. Background should be 10-20% opacity of the semantic color with text using 100% of the semantic color.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react` for system icons. For dashboard density, keep icon sizes consistent (`w-4 h-4` to `w-5 h-5`).
visual_enhancers.motion: Micro-interactions are mandatory. `transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5` for cards. Staggered fade-in (`framer-motion`) for list items. No 'transition: all'.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle SVG noise or grain background to the login page and public itinerary pages to prevent flatness.

omni_channel_sharing.instructions: Design a clean modal with tabs (WhatsApp, Email, Copy Link). Include pre-formatted text preview areas.

leads_kanban.instructions: Drag-and-drop columns (New, Contacted, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Won, Lost). Cards should display lead name, destination, and budget clearly.

vendor_inventory.instructions: Data-dense tables for Hotels and Vehicles. Include sticky headers, inline editing (or click-to-edit modal), and status toggles.

itinerary_builder.instructions: Vertical timeline layout for day-by-day plan. Live cost calculator fixed on the right side or bottom sticky bar.

bookings_invoices.instructions: Split view: list on left, details on right. Use progress bars for payment tracking (Advance/Balance).

image_urls.description: Modern luxury hotel at sunset. Use for header image in the public shareable itinerary page.
Beautiful mountain landscape. Use as an itinerary destination placeholder.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text has 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds. Use text-shadow over images.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2`).

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="kanban-card-1"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML-based defaults for Datepickers, Selects, or Dialogs. Use Shadcn equivalents.
Do NOT use `transparent` backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdown menus.
Always apply hover, focus, and active states. Use `hover:text-white` when changing background to dark.
Do NOT center align dashboard layouts. Everything should be left-aligned naturally.
Inject the provided image URLs natively. NEVER use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on-distribution' AI slop outputs. Create distinctive frontends.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Never use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use the approved icon library.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
